gold: Drug-induced dermatomyositis secondary to ipilimumab therapy

selector.rationale: Skin symptoms and specific dermatomyositis findings such as Gottron's papules and nailfold changes support this diagnosis, despite the lack of inflammatory myositis on biopsy, which may have been affected by corticosteroid treatment

rejected.label: Ipilimumab-induced dermatitis
rejected.why: Limited findings specific to dermatitis and lack of comprehensive explanation for muscle weakness and other systemic symptoms

rejected.label: Lupus-like syndrome
rejected.why: Insufficient specific findings to support a lupus-like syndrome diagnosis beyond a positive antinuclear antibody titer

support_spans: Flat-topped pink to erythematous papules over knuckles
Prominent erythema at nailfolds with dilated capillary loops, capillary dropout, and ragged cuticles
Within 2 weeks of starting ipilimumab treatment, she developed skin symptoms
contradict_spans: Vastus lateralis muscle biopsy showed atrophy of type II muscle fibers without evidence of inflammatory myositis
